# TimelineChart

**Class:** `UltraCanvasTimelineChart` · **Group:** [Charts](../Groups/Charts.md) · **Header:** [`UltraCanvas/include/Plugins/Charts/UltraCanvasTimelineChart.h`](../../../UltraCanvas/include/Plugins/Charts/UltraCanvasTimelineChart.h) · `#include "Plugins/Charts/UltraCanvasTimelineChart.h"`

**Inherits:** [`UltraCanvasChartElementBase`](UltraCanvasChartElementBase.md) → [`UltraCanvasUIElement`](UltraCanvasUIElement.md) → `Element`

## What it is for

Milestones and spans on a real date axis

## Creating it

Factory functions (the usual way - every element is held in a `std::shared_ptr`):

```cpp
TimelineChartStyle CreateForDesign(TimelineChartDesign design);
std::shared_ptr<UltraCanvasTimelineChart> CreateTimelineChartElement( const std::string& id, int x, int y, int width, int height);
std::shared_ptr<UltraCanvasTimelineChart> CreateTimelineChartElement( const std::string& id, int x, int y, int width, int height, TimelineChartDesign design);
std::shared_ptr<UltraCanvasTimelineChart> CreateTimelineChartWithData( const std::string& id, int x, int y, int width, int height, std::shared_ptr<TimelineChartDataSource> data, TimelineChartDesign design);
```

Constructors:

```cpp
UltraCanvasTimelineChart(const std::string& id, int x, int y, int w, int h);
```

The first string argument is always the element's **identifier**, never its text (see [Core concepts](../Core-Concepts.md#identifiers)).

## Callbacks

Assign a lambda to the member (or call the setter). Capture the element and its parents **raw**, never as a `shared_ptr` - see [Events and callbacks](../Events-and-Callbacks.md#ownership).

|---|---|---|
| `onEntrySelect` | `std::function<void(size_t, const TimelineChartEntry&)> onEntrySelect` | _Entry select_ |

| `onEntryDoubleClick` | `std::function<void(size_t, const TimelineChartEntry&)> onEntryDoubleClick` | _Entry double click_ |
| `onSelectionChange` | `std::function<void()> onSelectionChange` | _Selection change_ |
| `onViewChanged` | `std::function<void()> onViewChanged` | _View changed_ |

## Option types in this header

### enum `TimelineEntryKind`

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `Milestone` | Point in time, drawn as a marker on the axis |
| `Span` | Date range, drawn as a bar in a packed lane |
| `Era` | Date range, drawn as a background band behind everything |
| `Bookend` | Point in time anchored to the axis end (project start/end) |

| `Rounded` |  |

### enum `TimelineAxisPosition`

Where the date axis sits inside the plot area.

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `Top` | Axis at the top, everything hangs below it |
| `Bottom` | Axis at the bottom, everything stacks above it |
| `Center` | Axis in the middle, entries above and below |

### enum `TimelineLabelPlacement`

How an entry's label is placed relative to its bar/marker.

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `Hidden` |  |
| `InsideBar` | Inside the bar when it fits, callout otherwise |
| `Callout` | Always beside/above the entry with a leader line |
| `AutoPlace` | Inside when it fits, otherwise a callout |

| Value | Meaning |

| `CorporateBlue` |  |
| `Vibrant` |  |

| `Sunset` |  |
| `Forest` |  |
| `Slate` |  |
| `Mono` |  |
| `Custom` |  |

### enum `TimelineLaneMode`

How entries are assigned to rows.

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `Packed` | Auto-packed into as few lanes as fit (default) |
| `Swimlanes` | One named band per category, sub-packed inside the band |

### enum `TimelineChartDesign`

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `Classic` | Flat bars, plain header, print friendly |
| `Modern` | Rounded colorful bars, tinted header bands |
| `Minimal` | Thin line bars, hairline grid |
| `Roadmap` | Big markers, era bands, quarter header |
| `Dark` | Dark background variant of Modern |

### struct `TimelineSwimlane`

One named row of a swimlane timeline. Entries are assigned to a lane by TimelineChartEntry::swimlaneName.

| Field | Declaration | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `name` | `std::string name` |  |
| `detail` | `std::string detail` | Optional second header line (owner, team) |
| `color` | `Color color = Color(0, 0, 0, 0)` | Transparent = palette entry for this row |

### struct `TimelineChartEntry`

| Field | Declaration | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `kind` | `TimelineEntryKind kind = TimelineEntryKind::Milestone` |  |
| `name` | `std::string name` |  |
| `detail` | `std::string detail` | Second label line (a date caption, an owner) |
| `iconGlyph` | `std::string iconGlyph` | Short text/glyph drawn inside the marker |
| `start` | `double start = 0.0` | Day serials since 1970-01-01, fractional part = time of day. Milestones use `start` only; span ends are inclusive-exclusive, so a one-day span is start..start+1. |
| `end` | `double end = 0.0` |  |
| `openEnded` | `bool openEnded = false` | Span with no known end: fades out |
| `startUncertainty` | `double startUncertainty = 0.0` | Uncertainty in days, drawn as a lighter extension on each end |
| `endUncertainty` | `double endUncertainty = 0.0` |  |
| `lane` | `int lane = -1` | 1 = pack automatically |
| `side` | `int side = 0` | 1 above the axis, +1 below, 0 = automatic |
| `swimlaneName` | `std::string swimlaneName` | Row this entry belongs to in Swimlanes mode |
| `color` | `Color color = Color(0, 0, 0, 0)` | Transparent = palette |
| `marker` | `TimelineMarkerStyle marker = TimelineMarkerStyle::Diamond` |  |
| `importance` | `float importance = 1.0f` | Scales the marker; higher wins label space |
| `progress` | `float progress = -1.0f` | 0..1 on a span; &lt; 0 = no progress display |
| `tooltip` | `std::string tooltip` | Overrides the generated tooltip |
